source: NCERT Class VIII, Curiosity: Textbook of Science, Ch. 3.

sections.heading: 1. What is Health
points: **Health** = a state of complete **physical, mental and social well-being** — not merely the absence of disease.
Good health depends on **balanced diet, clean water, hygiene, exercise, rest and a healthy environment**.
Health is a **treasure** to be protected.

sections.heading: 2. Nutrition and Balanced Diet
points: A **balanced diet** provides all nutrients — **carbohydrates, proteins, fats, vitamins, minerals** — plus water and roughage.
**Deficiency diseases:** scurvy (vit C), rickets (vit D), anaemia (iron), goitre (iodine), night blindness (vit A).
**Malnutrition** includes both **undernutrition** and **over-nutrition (obesity)**.

sections.heading: 3. Diseases and their Spread
points: **Communicable (infectious) diseases** — caused by microbes and spread from person to person (e.g. cold, TB, malaria).
**Non-communicable diseases** — not spread by contact (e.g. diabetes, heart disease, cancer).
Spread through **air, water, food, contact and carriers** (e.g. mosquitoes).

sections.heading: 4. Immunity, Prevention and Hygiene
points: **Immunity** = the body's ability to **fight infection**; **white blood cells** and **antibodies** defend the body.
**Vaccination (immunisation)** trains the body to resist specific diseases (e.g. polio, measles).
Prevention: **personal hygiene (washing hands), clean surroundings, safe water and food, exercise, avoiding tobacco/alcohol/drugs**.
**Mental health** matters too — rest, positive relationships, managing stress.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: Health = physical + mental + social well-being (not just absence of disease).
Balanced diet prevents deficiency diseases (scurvy=C, rickets=D, anaemia=iron, goitre=iodine).
Communicable (spread by microbes) vs non-communicable diseases.
Immunity = body's defence (WBCs, antibodies); vaccination builds it.
Prevention: hygiene, clean water/food, exercise, avoid tobacco/alcohol.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: **Health** is more than the absence of disease — it includes **mental and social** well-being.
**Communicable** diseases spread by microbes; **non-communicable** (diabetes, cancer) do not.
**Vaccination** builds immunity against **specific** diseases.
**Malnutrition** covers both under- and over-nutrition.
